title: Monitoring & Observability
description: Learn how to monitor, debug, and maintain production systems. Master Prometheus, Grafana, logs vs metrics vs traces, alerting strategies, and SLA/SLO/SLI frameworks.
objectives: Understand the 3 pillars of observability (Logs, Metrics, Traces)
Set up Prometheus metric collection and PromQL queries
Distinguish between SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs
Configure alerting and incident management workflows
